title: Yellow Mustardy Vietnamese Lamb Kidney Noodles
description: A weeknight Vietnamese dish featuring lamb kidney and mustardy flavors, this recipe is a flexitarian-friendly option for a quick dinner.
instructions: Press the saute button on the pressure cooker and heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil until shimmering.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the sliced lamb kidney and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the yellow mustard, fish sauce, and lime juice, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the pressure cooker and close the lid, making sure the valve is set to sealing.
Pressure cook the mixture for 10 minutes, then let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes.
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and drain.
Stir in the cooked noodles, salt, and black pepper, and serve hot.
